tasks.short: Check, code and release supplier and staffing agency invoices in AFAS for the Rabobank payment run.

today.trigger: Invoice arrives in the AP mailbox or an agency portal; weekly payment run on Thursday.
steps: Open PDF or UBL invoice from Outlook and register it in AFAS Profit
Match to purchase order or contract; for agency invoices match hours and rates to the agency portal and site timesheets
Chase site managers by mail for approval of unmatched invoices
Code GL account, cost centre (Rotterdam, Tilburg, Venlo) and VAT
Build payment batch in AFAS and upload to Rabobank for approval
drudgery: Comparing agency hours line by line against portal exports
today.time_sinks: Flex worker invoices from three agencies with different layouts, rate differences against the CAO pay scale, and approvals stuck with shift managers.

lenses.faster: Extraction, PO and hours matching and coding happen on arrival; the accountant only opens invoices that fail a match rule.
lenses.autonomous: Each new invoice triggers capture, three-way match and routing to the right approver; matched invoices within tolerance queue for the payment run without a touch.
lenses.ambitious: Check every agency invoice against approved hours, CAO scale and surcharges instead of sampling, and recover overbilling that today goes unseen.
lenses.joy: No retyping or chasing; what remains is resolving real disputes with agencies and suppliers.
lenses.options: For a disputed agency invoice, get three resolutions drafted: credit note request, partial payment, or rate correction with the calculation attached.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the match rules, tolerances and the touchless rate, and tunes them monthly from the exception log.
reach: Bookkeeper AP invoice entry and coding
Credit and Collections Officer duplicate payment checks
Payroll Specialist checks of flex hours against payroll cost

tasks.human_edge: Judging disputed charges, negotiating with agencies and suppliers, and approving the payment batch under four-eyes control.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps across AFAS, portals and mail with exceptions; payment must stay behind a human approval.

in_practice.trigger: New invoice in AP mailbox, Peppol inbox or agency portal export.
steps: Extract header and lines from PDF or read UBL directly
Match to PO, goods receipt or agency hours export with tolerance rules
Propose GL, cost centre and VAT code from history
Route exceptions to the approver in AFAS workflow with the mismatch explained
Queue matched invoices for the weekly batch; accountant and Finance Director approve in Rabobank
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant reviews exceptions and the batch summary; payment released with two signatures in Rabobank.
data_needed: Agency hours exports and agreed rate cards
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS invoice workflow history plus an exception log in SharePoint

evidence.claim: AP automation products capture invoices, match them to POs and route exceptions
Dutch OCR and invoice extraction services feed bookkeeping systems
Matching agency invoices to hours and CAO rates with an LLM plus rules is feasible

risks: Supplier bank detail change fraud passing a touchless flow
Agency invoices contain flex worker names and hours: personal data under AVG/GDPR, needs a processing record
research_questions: What share of invoices today has a PO or a matching hours export, and so could pass touchless?
Do the three agencies deliver structured hours files or only PDFs?
How much overbilling did last year's agency invoices contain on a sample of 200?
Does AFAS Profit's invoice workflow accept an external matching result through its API?

tasks.short: Prepare the monthly figures and check them for errors, gaps and policy fit before the controller signs off.

steps: Pull trial balance and subledgers from AFAS into Excel
Compare to prior month, budget and forecast; mark big variances
Check completeness: accruals booked, depreciation run, payroll journal posted
Ask budget holders and site managers for explanations
Write a variance note for the controller and FP&A
drudgery: Rebuilding the same Excel checks every month
today.time_sinks: Manual variance analysis per site and cost centre and waiting for explanations.

lenses.faster: A fixed check script runs on the AFAS extract and an LLM drafts the variance note; the accountant edits instead of building.
lenses.autonomous: Once the nightly extract shows the close journals posted, checks run and open items go to owners in Teams.
lenses.ambitious: Check every cost centre and every site every month, and do a light weekly close so the forecast rests on current numbers.
lenses.joy: No copy-paste; the accountant spends time on the variances that matter and on talking with the business.
lenses.options: Draft variance explanations at three levels of detail: board, site manager, controller.
lenses.altitude: The accountant maintains the check catalogue and thresholds and reviews which checks never fire.
reach: FP&A Analyst first-pass variance commentary
Controller completeness review

tasks.human_edge: Knowing what is behind a number at a site, judging materiality and taking responsibility for the figures.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic checks plus LLM drafting of explanations, with a person signing off what goes to the controller.

in_practice.trigger: Close journals posted in AFAS, detected in the nightly extract.
steps: Run completeness and consistency checks on the trial balance
Calculate variances against prior month, budget and forecast
Draft explanations from journal descriptions, invoices and mails
Send questions to budget holders in Teams
Accountant edits and sends the pack to the controller
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant approves the pack; controller signs off the month.
in_practice.logs_to: Close folder in SharePoint with check results and versioned note

evidence.claim: Close management software tracks checklists and flux analysis
Copilot in Excel drafts analysis and summaries of tables
LLM-drafted variance commentary from journal detail

risks: Plausible but wrong explanations accepted without checking
Nightly extract lag hides late postings
research_questions: How many hours per close go into variance analysis today?
Do journal descriptions in AFAS carry enough detail for useful explanations?
Which checks found real errors in the last 12 closes?

tasks.short: Reconcile bank, intercompany, payroll and agency accounts and clear the differences.

today.trigger: Daily bank statements and month-end balance sheet reconciliations.
steps: Download Rabobank statements and match to open items in AFAS
Reconcile payroll clearing and tax accounts with the AFAS payroll journal
Reconcile intercompany between sites and agency accrual accounts
Investigate unmatched items by mail and phone
Record reconciliations in Excel templates
today.time_sinks: Customer payments with missing or combined references and agency accruals that do not tie out.

lenses.faster: Rule-based matching clears most lines automatically; an LLM suggests matches for messy references.
lenses.autonomous: Every statement import runs matching; balance sheet reconciliations are prepared at close without being asked.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile all balance sheet accounts monthly, not just the big ones, which cuts audit adjustments.
lenses.joy: No ticking; only the odd items remain, which are the puzzles people like solving.
lenses.options: For an unmatched receipt, rank three likely invoices with a confidence score.
lenses.altitude: The accountant designs matching rules and reviews the auto-match rate and false matches.
reach: Bookkeeper cash allocation
Credit and Collections Officer unapplied cash follow-up

tasks.human_edge: Deciding write-offs and corrections and judging whether a difference signals an error or fraud.
tasks.pattern_why: Matching rules can be written down on structured bank and ledger data; an LLM helps only on free-text references.

in_practice.trigger: CAMT.053 statement import and month-end close.
steps: Import statements and open items
Apply exact and tolerance rules
Suggest matches for free-text references
Prepare reconciliation per account with unexplained items listed
Accountant clears exceptions and signs the reconciliation
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant approves manual matches and write-offs; controller reviews signed reconciliations.
in_practice.logs_to: Reconciliation file per account in SharePoint with preparer and reviewer

evidence.claim: Software automates account reconciliation and transaction matching
Bank matching in Dutch bookkeeping software uses statement imports and rules

risks: Rules drift as customers change payment behaviour
research_questions: What auto-match rate does AFAS reach today on Rabobank imports?
Which accounts cause most audit adjustments?
Is a separate reconciliation tool worth its licence for a 10-FTE team, or is AFAS plus scripts enough?

tasks.short: Check whether our books and AFAS processes are recorded correctly and efficiently.

today.trigger: Quarterly internal review, auditor's management letter, or a recurring error.
steps: Sample journals and transactions in AFAS
Walk through process steps with bookkeepers
Check authorisations and segregation of duties
Write findings and improvement points
today.time_sinks: Small samples that miss patterns, and reconstructing who did what from AFAS logs.

lenses.faster: Full-population analytics on the GL replace samples; the accountant reads flagged patterns.
lenses.autonomous: Monthly scan for manual journals, weekend postings, duplicate suppliers and rights conflicts.
lenses.ambitious: Test 100 percent of journals and map the real procure-to-pay flow, giving the auditor fewer surprises.
lenses.joy: Less sampling, more fixing processes with colleagues.
lenses.options: Draft several process fixes per finding with effort and expected effect.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the control framework and decides which tests run continuously.
reach: Controller internal control testing
Preparation for external auditor

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a pattern is a real control weakness and getting colleagues to change how they work.
tasks.pattern_why: Analysis can be automated but conclusions and recommendations stay with the accountant.

in_practice.trigger: Monthly after close and before the audit.
steps: Run full-population journal tests
Summarise flagged items and patterns
Accountant investigates and writes findings
Agree actions with owners
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant decides findings; controller approves the action list.
data_needed: Full GL journal lines with user and timestamp

evidence.claim: AI analyses full general ledger populations for anomalies

risks: User activity data is personal data and must not become performance monitoring without OR involvement
research_questions: Can AFAS export journal lines with user and timestamp for all entries?
What did the last two management letters flag?
Does analysis of employee posting behaviour need works council consent?

tasks.short: Book month-end accruals, deferrals and corrections in AFAS.

steps: Calculate accruals for agency hours not yet invoiced, holiday pay and utilities
Run depreciation and prepaid releases
Prepare correction entries from review findings
Upload memorial journals in AFAS with support attached
today.time_sinks: Agency hours accrual per site and rebuilding the holiday pay calculation.

lenses.faster: Recurring entries are generated from rules and source data; the accountant reviews proposals with support attached.
lenses.autonomous: At close, the agency hours accrual is calculated from portal hours minus invoices received and posted as a draft.
lenses.ambitious: Weekly accruals for flex labour, giving FP&A a near real-time labour cost view.
lenses.joy: No rebuilding spreadsheets; time goes to unusual items.
lenses.options: Show accrual estimates under different assumptions, such as late hour approvals.
lenses.altitude: The accountant maintains the accrual rules and checks reversals and estimate accuracy.
reach: FP&A Analyst labour cost forecasting
Payroll Specialist holiday pay reserve checks

tasks.human_edge: Estimates that need judgement and accountability for what gets booked.
tasks.pattern_why: Data from several systems, rules plus judgement, and every entry needs approval before posting.

steps: Pull hours, open POs, payroll data and fixed asset register
Calculate recurring entries by rule
Draft non-recurring corrections from review findings with explanation
Post as draft journals in AFAS
Accountant approves; controller approves above threshold
in_practice.human_gate: Every journal approved before posting; above threshold also by the controller.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS journal with attached calculation and approver

evidence.claim: Close tools generate recurring and accrual journal entries

research_questions: How large is the gap between agency accrual and final invoice today?
Can portal hours be pulled automatically from all three agencies?
Which entries are truly recurring?

tasks.short: Divide and check the bookkeepers' work on entering, filing and sending financial records.

steps: Assign AP, AR and filing work to three bookkeepers
Track progress in Excel and Teams
Review samples of their entries
Answer questions and handle escalations
today.time_sinks: Status tracking and rework from unclear instructions.

lenses.faster: Work queues and close status come from AFAS workflow data; no status meetings or lists.
lenses.autonomous: Tasks are assigned from the queue and overdue items flagged in Teams.
lenses.ambitious: Bookkeepers move from entry to handling exceptions, with clear work instructions per exception type.
lenses.options: Draft alternative work splits for peak season when flex invoices double.
lenses.altitude: The accountant designs the workflow and work instructions instead of directing each step.
reach: Controller close calendar management

tasks.human_edge: Coaching, fairness and judgement in managing people.
tasks.pattern_why: Leading people stays human; AI supplies status, instructions and drafts.

steps: Build status from AFAS workflow and close checklist
Flag overdue and blocked items
Draft work instructions from resolved exceptions
Accountant decides priorities
in_practice.human_gate: The accountant assigns and reviews work.

evidence.claim: Close checklists with task status and owners

risks: Dashboards used to monitor individual productivity, which needs works council consent under the WOR
Bookkeepers feeling replaced without a plan for their role
research_questions: How much of bookkeepers' time is entry versus exceptions today?
What does the OR need to approve for work-queue data?
Which exception types recur enough for written instructions?

tasks.short: Maintain the chart of accounts and cost centres, and make sure entries land on the right account.

today.trigger: New cost type, site change, reporting change, or miscoded postings.
steps: Create or change GL accounts and cost centres in AFAS
Set default coding for suppliers
Review miscodings and reclassify
Keep the mapping to Power BI reports current
today.time_sinks: Reclassification at month end and mapping breaks in Power BI.

lenses.faster: An LLM proposes the account and cost centre per line from description and history; only uncertain lines go to a person.
lenses.autonomous: Monthly scan flags likely miscodings and proposes reclassifications.
lenses.ambitious: Code cost per site, client and activity, so warehouse margin per customer becomes visible.
lenses.options: Propose several chart structures for a reporting need, with impact on reports and history.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the chart design and coding rules.
reach: Bookkeeper coding
FP&A Analyst report mapping

tasks.human_edge: Designing the chart for how the business is steered and audit needs.
tasks.pattern_why: Free-text invoice lines to a fixed list of accounts inside the AFAS workflow, checkable against history.

in_practice.trigger: Each new invoice line or journal; monthly miscoding scan.
steps: Suggest account and cost centre with confidence
Auto-apply above threshold, else to queue
Scan posted lines for outliers
Accountant approves reclassifications and chart changes
in_practice.human_gate: Chart changes and reclassifications approved by the accountant; big structure changes by the controller.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS audit trail and a coding change log

evidence.claim: Machine learning suggests GL coding for invoices

risks: Chart changes breaking Power BI history
research_questions: How accurate is coding today, from a sample of 300 lines?
Is the chart detailed enough for margin per customer?
Does AFAS allow setting coding through its API?

tasks.short: Build and document Excel tools, AFAS settings, reports and scripts that run our bookkeeping.

today.trigger: New requirement, audit finding, or a manual step that hurts.
steps: Write down the requirement
Build Excel models, AFAS workflows or Power BI reports
Test with real data
Write procedures in SharePoint
today.time_sinks: Building without coding skills and keeping documentation current.

lenses.faster: AI coding assistants write SQL, Power Query and Python against AFAS GetConnectors and draft documentation.
lenses.autonomous: Documentation regenerates when a script or workflow changes.
lenses.ambitious: Replace fragile Excel tools with tested, versioned scripts that the auditor can review.
lenses.joy: Building becomes the fun part; documentation chores shrink.
lenses.options: Prototype two or three designs and test them on last month's data.
lenses.altitude: The accountant becomes the owner of finance automation: requirements, testing, change control.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst reporting builds
FP&A Analyst model building

tasks.human_edge: Knowing what the process must do and controlling change in a system auditors rely on.
tasks.pattern_why: The accountant leads design and testing; AI speeds code and documentation.

in_practice.trigger: Change request on the finance backlog.
steps: Describe requirement and test cases
AI drafts code or configuration
Test on copied data
Peer review and document
Deploy with change log
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant tests; controller approves changes affecting financial reporting.
in_practice.logs_to: Change log in SharePoint and version control

evidence.claim: AI coding assistants write SQL and Python
Copilot helps build Power BI reports

risks: Personal data from AFAS copied into test files
research_questions: Which Excel tools are critical and undocumented?
Does IT allow scripts on AFAS connectors?
Can the auditor rely on scripted controls?

role.altitude: From doing invoices, reconciliations and journals to owning the finance automation: match rules, accrual rules, controls and the touchless rate, with exceptions as the main daily work.
reach: Bookkeeper invoice entry, coding and cash allocation
FP&A Analyst variance commentary and labour cost forecasting
Controller close checklist and internal control testing
Payroll Specialist checks of flex hours and holiday pay reserve
Credit and Collections Officer unapplied cash
role.ceiling_note: Roughly 300 of about 1,330 hours per FTE per year in these tasks could be freed; the limit is judgement, accountability for the books, audit acceptance, and data quality from agencies and AFAS.
skills_to_grow: Rule and workflow design in AFAS
SQL, Power Query and basic Python
Explaining AI-assisted work to the auditor and the works council
role.ambitious_version: A three-day close with a weekly soft close, every agency invoice checked against hours and CAO rates, all balance sheet accounts reconciled monthly, and margin per customer and site reported, run by two accountants who manage the system instead of the entries.
